title: 30-Day Viral Vault
summary: Plan 30 days, prepare six rights-cleared posts daily, and review exactly one post at a time before an approved schedule or local handoff.
triggers: prepare my six daily posts one at a time
show my next Viral Vault post

inputs.name: verified creator setup and six eligible daily sources

outputs.name: 30-day blueprint and sequential daily review packet

free_capabilities: durable local approval and recovery state
paid_capability_stubs: connected source reads, editable drafts, validation, best-time evidence, and scheduling depend on current Threadify scopes and entitlement

instructions: Use user-supplied owned, licensed, or permissioned sources and verified facts.
Keep the exact current card local and report unavailable provider capabilities.
Never claim a draft was saved, validated, scheduled, published, viral, or lead-generating without matching evidence.

must_prove: goal and six confirmed daily times
source rights and exact copy hash
schedule readback or local fallback state
